subtitle.mapping: Confirm which column maps to each field.
subtitle.preview: Invalid rows are skipped. Only valid rows are imported.
subtitle.committing: Creating one record per valid row.

upload.headersNote: The first row must be column headers. Up to {{max}} rows.

mapping.requiredAlert: Map every required field to continue.
mapping.requiredLegend: * Required. The import cannot continue until it is matched.

paste.label: Or paste rows copied from a spreadsheet
paste.helper: Include the header row. Columns separated by tabs, as copied from a sheet.

error.keyTooLong: Line reference must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.itemCodeTooLong: Item code must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.descriptionTooLong: Description must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.unitTooLong: Unit must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.quantity: Quantity must be a number above 0 (up to 3 decimals).
error.rate: Rate must be a number of 0 or more (up to 2 decimals).
error.lineNoWhole: Line number must be a whole number.
error.lineNoRange: Line number is out of range.
error.basis: Charged by must be a unit rate or a lump sum.
error.lumpSumQuantity: A lump-sum line must have quantity 1.

contractLines.keyHint: Unique for each line. A line whose reference is already on this contract is skipped.
contractLines.lineNoHint: Optional. Sets the order of the lines; lines without one come last.
contractLines.earningBasisHint: Optional. Unit rate (quantity × rate) or lump sum (one amount, quantity 1).
contractLines.existingUnavailable: Could not check for lines already on this contract. Any line already there will be skipped at import.
contractLines.nothingNew: Nothing to import: every valid line is already on this contract.

rateCatalogue.effectiveFromHint: Written as year-month-day, e.g. 2026-01-31. The rates below apply from this date.
rateCatalogue.rateHint: Rate for this location variant. Leave blank for no rate.
rateCatalogue.stagesHint: Optional. Stage name and percent, e.g. Fabrication=10; Welding=80; Testing=10. Must add up to 100.

error.effectiveFrom: Effective from must be a date written year-month-day.
error.rate: A rate must be a number of 0 or more (up to 2 decimals).
error.noRate: Give at least one location rate.
error.stagesFormat: Stage weights must read like Fabrication=10; Welding=80.
error.stagesSum: Stage weights must add up to 100.
error.duplicate: This item code appears twice in the sheet.

existing.unavailable: Could not check which records already exist.

crewImport.name: Name
crewImport.codeHint: Your own code for the crew. Each live crew has its own code.
crewImport.kindHint: own or vendor. Blank means own.
crewImport.vendorHint: Required for a vendor crew: the name of an existing company.
crewImport.controllerHint: The name of an existing user.
crewImport.rolesHint: Optional. Role name and headcount, e.g. Welder=2; Fitter=3.
crewImport.alreadyThere: A live crew with this code already exists.

error.name: Name is required.
error.kind: Crew type must be own or vendor.
error.rolesHeadcount: Each role headcount must be a whole number from 1 to 500.
error.rolesLong: A role name is too long (60 characters at most).
error.rolesRepeat: A role name is listed twice.
error.rolesFormat: Standard roles must read like Welder=2; Fitter=3.
error.vendorNeeded: A vendor crew needs its vendor company.
error.vendorNotAllowed: An own-staff crew has no vendor company.
error.repeat: This crew code already appears in row {n}.

crewMemberImport.crewHint: The code of a live crew.
crewMemberImport.workerHint: The person's code or name, as in the people register.
crewMemberImport.roleHint: Optional. One of the crew's standard roles.
crewMemberImport.toHint: Optional. Leave blank for no end date.
crewMemberImport.alreadyThere: This person is already placed in this crew from this date.

error.role: This is not one of the crew's standard roles.
error.overlapInFile: This person is already placed on overlapping dates in row {n}.
error.overlap: These dates overlap another placement of this person. End that one first.

stockItem.name: Name
stockItem.codeHint: Your own code for the item. Each code is used once.
stockItem.unitHint: The code of an existing unit of measure.

error.name: Name is required.
error.lead: Lead time must be a whole number of days.

stockLocation.name: Name
stockLocation.projectHint: Required for site, yard and staging; leave blank for central.

error.name: Name is required.
error.kind: Kind must be central, site, yard, staging or vendor.
error.projectNeeded: A project is required for this kind of location.
error.projectNotAllowed: A central location has no project.
error.projectNotAllowedVendor: A vendor location has no project.

equipment.name: Name
equipment.vendorHint: Required when rented: the name of an existing supplier.

error.name: Name is required.
error.unit: Default unit must be hours or days.
error.ownership: Ownership must be owned or rented.
error.rate: Rental rate must be a number above 0, with at most 2 decimals.
error.basis: Rate basis must be day or month.
error.currency: Currency is not one the organisation uses.
error.vendorNeeded: Supplier is required for a rented asset.
error.rateNeeded: Rental rate is required for a rented asset.
error.basisNeeded: Rate basis is required for a rented asset.
error.currencyNeeded: Currency is required for a rented asset.
error.startNeeded: Rental start is required for a rented asset.
error.endBefore: Rental end is before the rental start.

people.name: Display name
people.codeHint: Your own code for the person. A code already in the register updates that person; a new code adds one.

error.name: Display name is required.
error.repeat: This employee code already appears in row {n}.

people.jobTitleHint: Optional. Blank leaves the stored job title as it is.
people.managerHint: Optional. The manager's sign-in email; they must be an active user. Blank leaves the stored manager as it is.
people.noChange: Already in the register with these values.
people.unavailable: Could not read the people register, so changes cannot be previewed. Try again.
people.nothingToDo: Nothing to add or change: every row matches the register.

clientTakeoff.itemHint: The code of a client-supplied item.
clientTakeoff.requestedHint: Optional. Blank means the take-off quantity.

error.quantity: Enter a quantity above 0 with at most 3 decimal places.
error.itemUnknown: Item code not found among the client-supplied items.
error.whole: This item is counted in whole units.
error.repeat: This item already appears in row {n}.

personDocument.personHint: The code of a person in the register.
personDocument.typeHint: A document type from Administration, by name.
personDocument.numberHint: Optional. Blank leaves the stored number as it is.
personDocument.issuedHint: Optional. Year-month-day. Blank leaves the stored date as it is.
personDocument.noChange: This document already has these values.
personDocument.unavailable: Could not read the existing documents, so changes cannot be previewed. Try again.
personDocument.nothingToDo: Nothing to add or change: every row matches an existing document.

error.medical: Document type "{type}" is a medical type. Medical documents are recorded on the person page, not imported.
error.issuedAfter: Issue date is after the expiry date.
error.repeat: This person already has this document type in row {n}.

stockMovement.dateHint: The day the stock moved. Not after the go-live date.
stockMovement.locationHint: The code of an existing stock location.
stockMovement.itemHint: The code of an existing stock item.
stockMovement.directionHint: in: received, returned or found. out: issued, used or returned to the supplier.
stockMovement.quantityHint: Whole numbers only for items counted in whole units.
stockMovement.unitCostHint: On an in row. Leave blank for client-supplied items (they are always at zero cost). Not used on out rows.
stockMovement.referenceHint: A delivery note, site report or other paper number.

error.date: Use a day written as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-01-15.
error.location: Write the code of the stock location.
error.item: Write the code of the stock item.
error.direction: Write in (stock arrived) or out (stock left).
error.quantity: Quantity must be above 0, with at most 3 decimals.
error.unitCost: Unit cost must be 0 or more, with at most 4 decimals.
error.reference: The reference is too long (100 characters at most).
